description: Kotlin port of the GenHTTP web server on JDK 25, running on its Netty engine (the counterpart of GenHTTP's ioxide engine): one Netty event loop per core on the native epoll transport, every connection served by a coroutine on the loop that accepted it, TLS through OpenSSL (netty-tcnative). Implemented with web services and a layout router, JSON via Jackson, Postgres via HikariCP and JDBC on a dispatcher beside the event loops.
